==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{l|en|news letter}}
* {{l|en|news-letter}}

===Etymology===
From {{com|en|news|letter}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈn(j)uzˌlɛtɚ/|a=GenAm}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈnjuːzˌlɛtə/|a=RP}}
* {{audio|en|En-us-newsletter.oga|a=US}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A [[periodically]] [[send|sent]] [[publication]] containing [[current events]] or the like, generally on a particular [[topic]] or [[gear]]ed toward a limited [[audience]].
